produces.objective: Trace which hosts receive a broadcast frame sent from a host in a given VLAN across switches joined by trunks, from a topology diagram.

measurement.passes_when: All embedded questions answered correctly (100%, unlimited attempts): which hosts receive an ARP broadcast in three VLAN topologies with trunks.
